The modern, uncluttered dashboard sits low, has a fresh design with premium materials, and is easy to get used to. The large panoramic sunroof, operable via roof buttons or voice commands, enhances the cabin’s airy feel. The short, premium gear lever wrapped in leatherette has silver and gloss-black accents and offers quick and smooth gear shifts. The ventilated leatherette front seats are well-cushioned and spacious, making it easy to find a comfortable driving position. The rear seats provide ample head, leg and shoulder room for three, but better under-thigh support would have made them even more comfortable. The dual-zone AC features a glossy panel, a clear display, large buttons, and small chrome toggle switches for temperature adjustment. A 360-degree camera with sharp footage and guidelines helps navigate tight spaces with ease. The flat-bottom steering, wrapped in leatherette, has brushed silver accents, large gloss-black buttons, and tilt/telescopic adjustability. Slim centre air vents, neatly tucked under the infotainment screen, feature large chrome louvres for efficient airflow control. The driver's seat gets electric adjustments for slide, recline, and height, along with a manually adjustable headrest for added comfort. The wide and adequately tall boot accommodates three cabin-sized suitcases and soft bags, with 60:40 split-folding seats for extra versatility. The 16-inch steel spare wheel uses a 205/65 R16 tyre for any emergencies.
